description_en: Queries user information in batches based on a list of user IDs
description_zh: 根据用户ID列表批量获取用户信息
kebab_example: aliyun linkvisual query-face-user-batch --user-id-list example-string --isolation-id ZheJiangHZ --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryFaceUserBatch

parameters.description_en: The list of user IDs. Specify the user IDs that were obtained and saved locally after users were added by calling the [AddFaceUser](~~288338~~) operation.
parameters.description_zh: 用户ID列表。请传入在调用[AddFaceUser](~~288338~~)接口添加用户后，获取并保存到本地的用户ID。
parameters.help_en: The list of user IDs. Specify the user IDs that were obtained and saved locally after users were added by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/288338.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 用户ID列表。请传入在调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/288338.html接口添加用户后，获取并保存到本地的用户ID
parameters.name: user_id_list

parameters.description_en: The business isolation ID, which is used to isolate data between different business applications under the same Alibaba Cloud account. This value must be the same as the **IsolationId** specified when you called the [AddFaceUser](~~288338~~) operation to add users.
parameters.description_zh: 业务隔离ID，用于隔离同一个阿里云账号下不同业务应用之间的数据。请与调用[AddFaceUser](~~288338~~)接口添加用户时设置的**IsolationId**保持一致。
